import{useCallback,useEffect,useMemo,useState}from"react";import{useForm}from"react-hook-form";import{useDispatch,useSelector}from"react-redux";import{getDisbursements,updateDisbursement,createDisbursement}from"modules/loan-operation/slices/disbursementSlice";import{showErrorToast,showSuccessToast}from"common/ToastMessage";import CommonMessage from"common/CommonMessage";const useDisbursementForm=()=>{const dispatch=useDispatch();const[createModalOpen,setCreateModalOpen]=useState(false);const[editValues,setEditValues]=useState([]);// row values to edit
const{control,reset,handleSubmit,setValue}=useForm({});const{disbursements,isLoading}=useSelector(state=>state.disbursements);useEffect(()=>{dispatch(getDisbursements());},[dispatch]);useEffect(()=>{reset({...editValues});},[reset,editValues]);const onSubmit=useCallback(async(body,editFlag)=>{try{if(editFlag){await dispatch(updateDisbursement({id:editValues===null||editValues===void 0?void 0:editValues.uuid,newData:body})).unwrap();showSuccessToast(CommonMessage.MFS00003.replace("%s","Disbursement"));}else{await dispatch(createDisbursement({...body})).unwrap();showSuccessToast(CommonMessage.MFS00001.replace("%s","Disbursement"));}reset();setEditValues("");setCreateModalOpen(false);await dispatch(getDisbursements());}catch(error){console.error("Error:",error);}},[dispatch,reset,editValues]);return useMemo(()=>({isLoading,onSubmit,handleSubmit,control,disbursements,setValue,createModalOpen,setCreateModalOpen:value=>setCreateModalOpen(value),setEditValues:value=>setEditValues(value),reset}),[control,handleSubmit,isLoading,onSubmit,disbursements,setValue,createModalOpen,setCreateModalOpen,reset,setEditValues,editValues]);};export default useDisbursementForm;
